phase_completion_rule: A phase checkpoint requires its applicable gates, documentation review, reviewed push and primary PR; continue to the next feasible R0-R7 action. Delivery completes only after actual merge/sync, and final Alpha requires all original R6 actual-product gates.

phases.title: Reconcile the repository and establish the delivery workflow
phases.milestone: WA-R0 — Current baseline and accountable delivery
phases.outcome: Preserved local work, current GitHub baseline, one governing roadmap, one execution ledger, and a functioning owner-authenticated phase PR workflow.

slices.title: Adopt without resetting
slices.work: Read the actual checkout, applicable AGENTS guidance, saved handoff and remote refs. Inventory dirty/untracked files and preserve unrelated work. Reconcile the already-merged native-desktop PR with the local branch before switching or pulling.
slices.completion_evidence: Local/remote branch and base facts are recorded; existing changes are retained and classified.

slices.title: Replace competing instructions
slices.work: Adopt this package, migrate the existing Alpha plan and status without losing historical evidence, and retire conflicting historical selectors from active guidance. Keep working build/dependency helpers.
slices.completion_evidence: Root AGENTS and active links point to this roadmap; prior P0–P6 are a historical crosswalk, not another current assignment.

slices.title: Create or reconcile GitHub tracking
slices.work: Discover actual milestones, phase issues, labels and PRs; reuse matching records by stable R identifiers. Establish one phase issue and milestone per R phase with slice checklists.
slices.completion_evidence: Real remote IDs/URLs are recorded and no duplicates or fabricated completed issues are introduced.

slices.title: Close the stale-documentation gap
slices.work: Correct README, CHANGELOG, ROADMAP, STATUS, NEXT and all active documentation from verified source/receipts. Preserve implemented foundation; record runtime claims separately from current source facts.
slices.completion_evidence: Documentation sweep and R0 phase PR are complete; first implementation target is R1.1.

gates.title: Git preservation and plan integrity
gates.passing_evidence: Review Git diff/status and parse the migrated JSON; all phase/slice/gate references resolve. No native build for documentation-only changes.

gates.title: Delivery workflow
gates.passing_evidence: Authenticate as the owner, push the reviewed phase branch and open its PR against main; verify head identity and record the URL. Finish the normal merge/sync cycle where permitted.

phases.title: Complete Manager-owned inference and context continuity wiring
phases.outcome: A native Manager-owned ordinary Responses/tool loop drives the existing continuity automation and can be controlled and observed from the GUI.

slices.title: Own an ordinary run
slices.work: Add or complete the smallest typed run service using existing project/session/transport contracts. Accept explicit project and task/run identity; compose its lifetime in the real Manager, not in the GUI or a fixture.
slices.completion_evidence: One authoritative run owner; start/status/cancel reach the real service and persist appropriate run identity.

slices.title: Execute the normal tool loop
slices.work: Handle provider response IDs, function-call correlation and results through existing native tool dispatch with exact project/run/generation binding. Serialize authoritative run transitions and persist resumable state.
slices.completion_evidence: A controlled fixture exercises normal work and tool output; offline/protocol failure produces an actionable run state, not a fabricated success.

slices.title: Feed actual context observations
slices.work: Call ContinuityAutomation::observe from the ordinary response/tool path. Deduplicate observations; separate lifetime token counters from retained context and publish the same authoritative values to telemetry.
slices.completion_evidence: Below-threshold work continues without count/time rollover; threshold observations enter one canonical continuity operation.

slices.title: Complete productive successor ownership
slices.work: Reuse canonical handoff retrieval, real root creation, exact provider acknowledgment and predecessor fencing. Resume ordinary useful work under the successor, including safe pause/cancel and uncertain-side-effect handling.
slices.completion_evidence: Focused tests prove no double accepted successor and no predecessor mutation after fencing; real-provider acceptance stays separately required in R6.

slices.title: Expose a minimal native control surface
slices.work: Wire Autonomy and Continuity to run start/pause/resume/stop, selected project/run, context state and errors. Closing/reopening the GUI must not own or duplicate execution.
slices.completion_evidence: The real Manager can be controlled from the native UI; the phase has a small actual attach/detach check.

gates.title: Affected build and focused regressions
gates.passing_evidence: Build affected native targets and run the existing Manager protocol, continuity automation and session-host fixture coverage that intersects the change; add only missing ordinary-run cases.

gates.title: Ordinary run functionality
gates.passing_evidence: Demonstrate a normal call/result chain, one bad/offline response and correct context deduplication/cancellation through the production service with a controlled transport fixture.

gates.title: Native control and ownership
gates.passing_evidence: Use the actual GUI/Manager in an isolated profile to exercise controls and reattachment without duplicate ownership; record live inference as not run when the provider is offline.

phases.title: Deliver real native telemetry and visual dashboards
phases.outcome: Real CPU/RAM/process collectors, supported GPU readings, operational measurements, and reusable native charts/gauges/timelines replace generic or unavailable placeholders.

slices.title: Implement the missing collectors
slices.work: Inspect existing ITelemetryService and telemetry/domain contracts. Replace the unconditional UnavailableTelemetryService production composition with native supported collectors; retain that adapter only for genuine unavailable capability fallback.
slices.completion_evidence: Machine CPU/RAM and Forge process readings are real; optional GPU capability discovery is attempted and failures are explicitly classified.

slices.title: Publish typed operational snapshots
slices.work: Compose timestamped snapshots of resources, Manager/runtime, provider, context, continuity, projects/runs/tools and store health. Reuse existing events and typed Manager transport.
slices.completion_evidence: The GUI consumes the same authoritative identities and context values as execution; collection works independently of window lifetime.

slices.title: Build reusable native visual controls
slices.work: Implement time-series resource/latency charts, context capacity/headroom bar or gauge, operational status cards and continuity/activity timeline with direct values, units and accessible text.
slices.completion_evidence: Visuals use actual data, bounded histories, sensible scales and unsupported/stale/error rendering without fabricated zeroes.

slices.title: Complete Rig and detail presentation
slices.work: Compose a readable Rig dashboard with drill-down into Provider, Continuity, Runtimes, Projects and Events. Persist relevant view settings; keep global and selected-project metrics distinct.
slices.completion_evidence: The main operational questions can be answered without opening raw logs or hovering for essential values.

slices.title: Verify freshness and UI lifetime
slices.work: Exercise connect/disconnect/reconnect, sample updates, window resize/scaling and keyboard access. Ensure no duplicate subscriptions or background UI callbacks after close.
slices.completion_evidence: Actual native visuals refresh without freezing the window; supported CPU/RAM integration cannot be waived as unavailable.

gates.title: Collector/mapping correctness
gates.passing_evidence: One focused test group covers valid deltas, unavailable/invalid measurements and stale/reset history. Reuse any existing collector and snapshot tests.

gates.title: Real sampling and rendering
gates.passing_evidence: Run the real app/Manager, compare scoped CPU/RAM/process values with a suitable Windows observation, show history changing, and exercise disconnected/stale rendering.

gates.title: Practical accessibility
gates.passing_evidence: Keyboard navigation and one enlarged/high-contrast layout pass; native visuals expose labels and equivalent values. No screenshot regression framework.

phases.title: Finish the native operating pages and local workflows
phases.outcome: Every named Alpha destination performs its real workflow rather than displaying a generic Manager refresh panel.

slices.title: Projects and memory workflow
slices.work: Complete project registration/selection, authorized folders, active bindings, memory search/read/write and persistence status in native views. Reuse the working native services.
slices.completion_evidence: Two disposable projects remain isolated; selecting one cannot silently redirect a different run.

slices.title: LM Studio MCP and native tools
slices.work: Provide primary/fallback deploy/inspect/repair actions, actual connection status and tool catalog/actions. Preserve foreign MCP entries and explicit shell preference.
slices.completion_evidence: A native UI-driven disposable file/search/Git/shell/memory workflow produces real effects.

slices.title: Agents, Tools and Feed
slices.work: Display actual agent/session identities, effective tool availability, recent activity, outcomes and durations. Connect available actions; do not invent independent model workers from catalog entries.
slices.completion_evidence: Lists and details share selected project/run scope and show actual successes and errors.

slices.title: Runtimes, Manager and diagnostics
slices.work: Finish runtime discovery/status and job controls that already belong to scope, Manager lifecycle, events/evidence navigation and concise diagnostics. Distinguish service stop from stopping a run.
slices.completion_evidence: All destinations have useful data/actions and missing optional runtimes have a specific availability state.

slices.title: Remove generic page substitutions
slices.work: Replace GenericPanel navigation fallbacks for required capabilities with feature views/view models. Recheck selected run/project after navigation and reconnect.
slices.completion_evidence: The required page matrix is fully implemented, with no disabled required-action placeholders.

gates.title: Focused local workflow regression
gates.passing_evidence: Reuse the existing disposable P2 workflow smoke or equivalent affected service test; check foreign MCP entry and second-project preservation.

gates.title: Native page walkthrough
gates.passing_evidence: Visit every required destination once and execute each essential distinct workflow, including one recoverable failure; capture a compact page checklist.

gates.title: Reattachment and persistence
gates.passing_evidence: Restart the isolated Manager or reopen the GUI once as appropriate; retain selected identities and persisted memory without duplicate jobs.

phases.title: Complete accessible settings and scoped maintenance
phases.milestone: WA-R4 — Accessible controls and safe reset
phases.outcome: Normal configuration and maintenance are accessible in the native GUI, persisted through the Manager and reflected by effective readback.

slices.title: Make settings discoverable
slices.work: Provide an obvious Settings destination and coherent links to Provider/Manager controls. Use labeled native controls and expose current effective configuration and pending edits.
slices.completion_evidence: Normal use does not require editing JSON or a developer shell.

slices.title: Provider credentials and model selection
slices.work: Finish validated endpoint/model/credential handling, model discovery, connection testing, save/revert and restart readback using existing secure storage and typed settings.
slices.completion_evidence: Errors and unavailable models are visible; automatic selection is never serialized as an unintended JSON null.

slices.title: Context and telemetry controls
slices.work: Expose context capacity and reserves/threshold explanation, paired sliders and exact numeric inputs, supported refresh/history/logging preferences, and shell/startup settings.
slices.completion_evidence: Controls update the effective Manager values; loaded model capacity and application threshold are distinguished; no tool-count quota is introduced.

slices.title: Project-scoped and all-store reset
slices.work: Implement or complete project-memory, continuity, combined and separately confirmed all-store maintenance. Coordinate live writers/leases and generations through existing services.
slices.completion_evidence: The selected scope is explicit; reset cannot erase source repositories or another project accidentally; late old-generation work cannot recreate reset state.

slices.title: Settings accessibility and failure handling
slices.work: Exercise keyboard/focus, scaling/high contrast, invalid input, cancelled confirmation and repeat save/restart. Keep ordinary settings edits independent of administrative certificate trust.
slices.completion_evidence: A practical GUI pass and concise readback/reset checks pass on disposable data.

gates.title: Settings persistence and validation
gates.passing_evidence: One focused group covers valid save/readback across restart plus invalid/cancelled input and the existing repeated-save regression.

gates.title: Reset scope and late writes
gates.passing_evidence: Reset disposable project A while preserving B; verify cancel changes nothing and old-generation work is rejected. Exercise all-stores only in an entirely disposable isolated environment.

gates.title: Native accessibility walkthrough
gates.passing_evidence: Operate Settings and a context slider/exact-value pair by keyboard; verify visible focus, accessible value labels and readable scaled/high-contrast layout.

phases.title: Finish the Windows installer and existing-data behavior
phases.outcome: A signed Release MSIX candidate has complete payload, ordinary installation/onboarding, stable identity, truthful data-compatibility handling and no development-path dependency.

slices.title: Preserve and diagnose existing data
slices.work: Reconfirm any outstanding schema mismatch from real metadata and relevant fetched history. Reuse --alpha-root for development. Recover authentic migrations when available; never falsify schema acceptance.
slices.completion_evidence: A precise compatibility contract distinguishes supported upgrade, rejected newer store and explicitly selected isolated startup.

slices.title: Complete package payload and provenance
slices.work: Reuse package.ps1 and existing assets. Include GUI, Manager, CLI, SessionHost, required resources/manifests and redistributable runtime dependencies. Validate every staged product belongs to one candidate.
slices.completion_evidence: Candidate metadata identifies source commit/tree, build configuration, package version, signature and hashes; source drive paths are not runtime dependencies.

slices.title: Finish trust/install experience
slices.work: Keep signed MSIX as the installer technology. Provide double-click/standard Windows installation and clear trust/dependency guidance, using the existing helper for the explicit elevated trust action only.
slices.completion_evidence: Normal approved installation is usable; only public certificate material is distributed and private keys/passwords never enter Git or the ZIP.

slices.title: First launch and profile recovery
slices.work: Make Start launch reach the installed Manager and MCP executables. Surface newer-store incompatibility in the GUI with a non-destructive explanation and explicit alternative path rather than a blank failure.
slices.completion_evidence: Installed start, folder/model configuration and subsequent launch do not require Visual Studio or the repository.

slices.title: Update and uninstall preservation
slices.work: Maintain stable package identity/publisher and a genuinely incremented numeric version for upgrade testing. Stop only owned test processes and verify retained user data and foreign MCP entries on update/uninstall.
slices.completion_evidence: Package mechanism and data-lifetime behavior are implemented; actual installed acceptance remains a named R6 requirement when external approval is unavailable.

gates.title: Release payload/signature
gates.passing_evidence: Build x64 Release products; pack and verify the actual signed MSIX, expected runtime payload and source/build provenance.

gates.title: Data compatibility behavior
gates.passing_evidence: Focused native persistence check on supported disposable fixtures and rejection of a newer store without mutation; no schema number downgrade or fabricated C008/C009.

gates.title: Installer procedure and versioning
gates.passing_evidence: Inspect and, where permission allows, execute trust/install/update preparation; separate package creation/signing from clean installed execution. Actual installed lifecycle is mandatory at R6.

phases.title: Run the small real-product acceptance pass and fix blockers
phases.outcome: Required native GUI, live managed continuity, installed workflow and data preservation are demonstrated on the candidate without fixture substitution.

slices.title: Real installed workflow
slices.work: Install the signed candidate on Windows 11 x64 without the source checkout or development tools. Launch through Start and execute project/MCP/native-tool/memory work.
slices.completion_evidence: Actual installed GUI/Manager/CLI/SessionHost paths and relevant persistence are recorded.

slices.title: Real context-triggered continuation
slices.work: Use a loaded tool-capable LM Studio model and a disposable task. Observe actual context reaching an effective threshold, fresh-root handoff retrieval, provider acknowledgment, predecessor fencing and useful automatic successor work.
slices.completion_evidence: A single end-to-end record contains correlated project/run/handoff/response IDs and actual successor effects; a fixture cannot satisfy it.

slices.title: GUI/telemetry/settings acceptance
slices.work: Complete the page matrix, verify live visual measurements and effective settings, and close/reopen the GUI during Manager-owned work.
slices.completion_evidence: All required native capabilities are exercised; unsupported hardware metrics are explained rather than fabricated.

slices.title: Installed lifecycle and required defect repair
slices.work: Perform one actual higher-version upgrade and one uninstall/reinstall as needed on disposable data. Fix required bugs and rerun only affected acceptance paths.
slices.completion_evidence: No known required functional/data-loss blocker remains. Existing schema-9 compatibility is either demonstrated or remains explicitly unaccepted; no silent scope waiver.

gates.title: Installed lifecycle
gates.passing_evidence: Install/Start launch/local workflow/memory persistence/upgrade/uninstall preservation all pass in the supported clean environment.

gates.title: Live provider continuity
gates.passing_evidence: Actual provider-originated acknowledgment and productive successor work pass; Manager ownership survives GUI detach.

gates.title: GUI and settings
gates.passing_evidence: Native page, visual telemetry, accessible settings and scoped reset checklist passes; all required bugs are fixed and affected regressions pass.

phases.title: Close documentation, merge the delivery PR and synchronize main
phases.outcome: The accepted candidate, current documentation, actual phase/PR evidence and local/main/remote identity agree; no public release is created by implication.

slices.title: Final documentation and traceability
slices.work: Reconcile every required capability with its phase/slice/test evidence; update README, CHANGELOG, ROADMAP and every active first-party document with final status, operator instructions and honest limitations.
slices.completion_evidence: All-doc review is complete, pending/verified/unsupported are not conflated and historic evidence remains unaltered.

slices.title: Finalize candidate and provenance
slices.work: Retain the tested signed candidate when code/package bytes are unchanged; rebuild and rerun only invalidated checks after fixes. Record complete installer hash, version and source tree in the delivery record.
slices.completion_evidence: Installer files exist and are locatable; the accepted tested bytes are identified. No invented download URL or unapproved public release.

slices.title: Deliver through the phase PR and prove synchronization
slices.work: Push under the owner account, open the R7 PR against main and follow normal merge rules. Fetch and fast-forward local main after actual merge; independently compare GitHub main, origin/main, local main and the clean tracked tree.
slices.completion_evidence: Every phase has its PR, required milestones are resolved, local main matches GitHub main and the final sync receipt is recorded without dirtying the tree.

gates.title: Final functional delta
gates.passing_evidence: Reuse R6 results for unchanged product bytes; build/test only a functional or packaging delta. A docs-only final phase needs no full regression rerun.

gates.title: Documentation and artifact
gates.passing_evidence: All active docs reconciled; JSON references valid; final installer hash/version/source evidence real; no required bugs hidden as deferred.

gates.title: PR and exact tracked-source sync
gates.passing_evidence: Final PR is actually merged; GitHub main, origin/main and local main SHAs agree, no tracked diff or unexplained publishable untracked files remain.
